name: Omatune
author: qempexe
description: Song recognition in your Omarchy bar: click to listen, then see the song, artist and cover in a notification and in the history. Needs SongRec installed.

barWidget.description: Song recognition with color, window, notification and history settings

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Follow theme matches your Omarchy theme live. Window borders takes the accent from your theme's window border. Custom lets you choose the background, text and accent. Monochrome removes every hue.

schema.label: Custom background
schema.description: Background, text and accent, used exactly as you pick them. A #rrggbb color, used when Colors is Custom.

schema.label: Custom text
schema.description: Background, text and accent, used exactly as you pick them. A #rrggbb color, used when Colors is Custom.

schema.label: Custom accent
schema.description: Background, text and accent, used exactly as you pick them. A #rrggbb color, used when Colors is Custom.

schema.label: Text
schema.description: Always readable keeps your theme's text color, and switches to black or white when the window is too light or too dark for it. My text color uses the Text color from Custom colors. Custom colors always use their own text color.

schema.label: Card style
schema.description: Soft fills cards lightly, outline draws a border only, flat has neither.

schema.label: Spacing
schema.description: How much air there is between things.

schema.label: Roundness
schema.description: 0 is square, 20 is very round.

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: 1 is normal, 1.25 is a quarter bigger.

schema.label: Show the cover
schema.description: The last song's cover in the Listen tab.

schema.label: Window width
schema.description: How wide Omatune opens.

schema.label: Window height
schema.description: How tall Omatune opens.

schema.label: Open as
schema.description: Where the bar button opens Omatune. You can always pop it out or dock it back from the header.

schema.label: Window outline
schema.description: Draw the edge in your window border's colors instead of a plain neutral line.

schema.label: Outline gradient
schema.description: Use the window border's whole gradient, at its angle, when it has more than one color.

schema.label: Outline color
schema.description: The one color the outline takes when it isn't a gradient.

schema.label: Window tint
schema.description: How much of the accent washes over the background. 0 keeps it plain.

schema.label: Window opacity
schema.description: 100 is solid.

schema.label: Listen to
schema.description: This computer records what is playing. Microphone listens to the room.

schema.label: Listen length
schema.description: Seconds to record before identifying. 4 to 6 is usually enough; longer is slower but finds more in noisy rooms.

schema.label: Notify when a song is found
schema.description: A desktop notification with the title and the artist.

schema.label: Cover in the notification
schema.description: The album cover as the notification's picture, when there is one.

schema.label: Notification time
schema.description: Seconds the notification stays on screen.

schema.label: Songs to keep
schema.description: How many songs the History tab remembers. Favourites are kept apart and don't count.

schema.label: Bar button shows
schema.description: While listening it always shows the countdown.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Up to 8 characters.

schema.label: Middle click
schema.description: What clicking the bar button with the middle mouse button does.
